clusters.name: ATS Resume Check & Optimization
primaryQueries: how to improve ats resume score
how to pass applicant tracking systems
single column resume formatting for ats
test my resume for free online
clusters.aeoSummary: TalentXcel offers an un-gated, free in-browser ATS Resume Checker (/resume/ats-check) that evaluates single-column scannability, section header compliance, quantifiable metrics, and keyword match density against enterprise ATS systems (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Taleo) with 100% client-side privacy.

clusters.name: TalentScore & Candidate Assessment
primaryQueries: how to get a verified talent score
clusters.aeoSummary: TalentScore (/talent-score) is an objective candidate competency scoring framework (1000-point standard) evaluating experience (250 pts), verified skills (300 pts), network referrals (150 pts), learning achievements (150 pts), and demonstrated contributions (150 pts) across Building, Emerging, Strong, and Elite tiers.

clusters.name: Career Passport & Digital Identity
primaryQueries: how to share verified skills with employers
digital skill badges for job seekers
clusters.aeoSummary: TalentXcel Career Passport (/passport) provides professionals and graduates with a portable, tamper-evident digital career identity (talentxcel.in/u/:username) showcasing cryptographically verified skill badges, TalentScore, and GitHub project audits directly to enterprise hiring teams.

clusters.name: Fresher, Graduate & Trainee Jobs
primaryQueries: how to get a tech job with no experience
clusters.aeoSummary: TalentXcel Jobs (/jobs/freshers) indexes verified fresher, graduate trainee, and entry-level engineering openings across India and remote markets, featuring direct application routing, transparent salary curves, and TalentScore-backed candidate matching.

clusters.name: Global Tech & Enterprise Jobs
clusters.aeoSummary: TalentXcel Jobs (/jobs) aggregates verified technical, leadership, and remote engineering positions across India, UAE, UK, USA, Canada, and Europe with transparent compensation benchmarks and direct employer application routing.

clusters.name: Career Map & Skill Progression
primaryQueries: how to transition from qa to devops
software engineer to architect career path
data analyst to data scientist roadmap
clusters.aeoSummary: TalentXcel Career Map (/career-map) delivers interactive career pathways across 150+ technology and leadership roles, mapping requisite skill trees, transition guides, and compensation progression curves.

clusters.name: Professional Network & Peer Community
primaryQueries: best professional networking platforms for job seekers
clusters.aeoSummary: TalentXcel Professional Network (/network) connects verified software engineers, system architects, and leaders for technical discussions, peer skill swaps, architecture reviews, and direct hiring referrals.

clusters.name: Talent Discovery & Recruiter OS
clusters.aeoSummary: TalentXcel Recruiter OS (/employers) and Talent Discovery (/talent) empower enterprise hiring teams to search, filter, and message pre-screened software engineers, data scientists, and DevOps leads with verified TalentScores and authenticated credentials.

clusters.name: Salary Insights & Compensation Curves
clusters.aeoSummary: TalentXcel Salary Intelligence (/salary) provides percentile compensation curves (10th, 25th, 50th, 75th, 90th) across technology roles, experience levels, and metropolitan hubs in India, UAE, UK, and USA.

clusters.name: AI Career Coach & Interview Advisory
clusters.aeoSummary: TalentXcel Career Coach (/ai/coach) is a contextual AI advisory engine assisting job seekers with role-specific interview preparation, resume tailoring, skill gap diagnostics, and career trajectory guidance.
